note: Machine-readable form of MASTER_WORKFLOW.md 'Parallelism Rules'. That document remains the explanation; this file is what an orchestrator reads so the rules are applied the same way on every run instead of being re-derived from prose. If the two ever disagree, the document wins and this file is the bug.

batchable_reads.rule: Independent reads within one stage may be issued in a single message. Writes are never batched, and any call depending on a prior result runs sequentially.

5: code files cited in the coding record

no_overlap_within_screen.rule: Stages are sequential because each consumes the previous artifact.

reasons.3b_after_2: Stage 3b codes against the contract Stage 2 froze.

exceptions.allowed_when: the Stage 2 backend contract is explicitly marked frozen in the screen plan
exceptions.consequence: The frontend codes against the documented contract, not a running server. A later backend deviation from the frozen contract is a Stage 5 blocker, not a frontend defect.

across_screens.rule: Parallelize across screens only when modules differ.
across_screens.second_axis: Frontend files are a second axis: two screens sharing a frontend layout, route group, or store count as the same module for partitioning even when their backend modules differ.

matrix.why: code lands in different directories; no shared file
still shares tests, services, and module-level files

dispatch.agents: one screen_group agent per module group
dispatch.shared_file_writes: queued in the parent, never performed by a group agent

failure_policy.group_failure: does not stop the other groups
failure_policy.aggregation: wait for all groups, then report one row per screen with artifacts, verdict, open follow-ups and group
failure_policy.ordering: list blockers first and state whether the green screens can proceed independently

high_finding_protocol.group_agent: pause and report the finding to the parent; do not prompt the user
high_finding_protocol.parent: collect HIGH findings across all groups, prompt once with a numbered list, then dispatch the decisions back
high_finding_protocol.why: avoids fragmented prompts across many screens, which is what makes a large batch unusable
